name: obligations-pane
description: The memory pane: a side pane over a memory-kit home's memory, one tab per tier (obligations, scratchpad, commitments, rules, lessons, facts, keys, secrets); read-only

agentName.title: Agent name
agentName.description: The name the footer shows for this session's main agent. A home's agent_name: in its memory-kit.conf wins over it. Empty uses the working directory's name.

memoryDir.title: Memory directory
memoryDir.description: The kit home's memory directory, for a session that runs outside the home. Relative paths resolve against the session's working directory. Empty reads memory_dir from <cwd>/memory-kit.conf, else <cwd>/memory.

autoOpen.title: Open at session start
autoOpen.description: Open the pane when a session starts in a folder that has an obligations file (it still waits for a wide enough terminal). /memory-pane or /obligations opens it any time.

checkUpdates.title: Check for kit releases
checkUpdates.description: At most every 6 hours, ask the kit's upstream (memory-kit.conf upstream:, default codeberg.org mitselek/memory-kit) for its release tags, and show a newer one in the header. It only tells; it never pulls. Off makes no request at all.
